seo__browser_title: Staple Food Packs — Oakdene House Foundation
seo__search_description: Free take-home grocery packs every Friday at Oakdene House, Fairfield. Includes fresh produce, pantry staples and hygiene items.
hero__intro: Take-home grocery packs for people doing it tough.
intro_details__text: In collaboration with OzHarvest, we provide free staple food packs to people experiencing financial hardship. Packs include fresh produce, pantry essentials and hygiene items where available.
food_image__image_alt: Oakdene Kitchen staff serving a meal
rules_eligibility__list: Packs are limited — once given out, none are available until next week
rules_eligibility__text: The same eligibility applies as the Oakdene Kitchen:
rules_eligibility__text_2: Also running on Fridays — if you need further support, speak with a team member about other Oakdene services including the [Kitchen](/community-programs/oakdene-kitchen/), [Laundrette](/community-programs/oakdene-laundrette/) and [Counselling](/services/individual-counselling/).
data__included: Hygiene items — women's health, child/baby, dental (subject to availability)
